tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Default · page background. True near-black with a whisper of warmth so the mid-tone colours glow.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Default · cards and sections sitting on surface-0.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Default · raised panels, hovered cards, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Default · popovers, menus, the highest layer.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default · hairline borders and dividers on any surface.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Default · emphasized borders, secondary button outline, hover state of line.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Default · headings and body text on every surface (14:1 or better).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Default · supporting text and descriptions on every surface (6.6:1 or better).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Default · metadata, dates, captions and placeholders (4.8:1 or better on every surface).

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Default · the primary accent: primary buttons, links, focus rings, active states. As text, on any surface. One clay-filled action per view.

tokens.name: clay-deep
tokens.usage: Default · pressed state of clay fills; large decorative blocks.

tokens.name: clay-soft
tokens.usage: Default · clay text on clay-tint backgrounds; highlights.

tokens.name: clay-tint
tokens.usage: Default · translucent background behind clay-soft text (tags, selected rows).

tokens.name: on-clay
tokens.usage: Default · text and icons on a clay fill (5.4:1). White on clay fails contrast, so labels are dark.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Default · secondary colour for tags, highlights and illustration. Not a status colour.

tokens.name: sage-deep
tokens.usage: Default · decorative blocks and pressed states for sage.

tokens.name: sage-soft
tokens.usage: Default · sage text on sage-tint backgrounds.

tokens.name: sage-tint
tokens.usage: Default · translucent background behind sage-soft text.

tokens.name: lagoon
tokens.usage: Default · secondary colour for tags, highlights and illustration. Not a status colour.

tokens.name: lagoon-deep
tokens.usage: Default · decorative blocks and pressed states for lagoon.

tokens.name: lagoon-soft
tokens.usage: Default · lagoon text on lagoon-tint backgrounds.

tokens.name: lagoon-tint
tokens.usage: Default · translucent background behind lagoon-soft text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Default · keyboard focus ring; follows clay, so retinting clay moves it too.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Default · shipped, passed, done. Always paired with an icon and a label so it never reads as sage.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Default · needs a look, degraded. Always paired with an icon and a label so it never reads as Owl's ember.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Default · failed, error, destructive. Always paired with an icon and a label so it never reads as clay.

tokens.name: flock-wren
tokens.usage: Flock · Wren, keeper of space. Sand: a small brown bird that keeps things tidy. Its avatar, menu bar bird and status accents.

tokens.name: flock-swift
tokens.usage: Flock · Swift, the builder. Sky: speed. Its avatar, reports and status accents.

tokens.name: flock-crow
tokens.usage: Flock · Crow, the inventor. Iris: the purple sheen on a crow's feathers. Its avatar and pitch cards.

tokens.name: flock-owl
tokens.usage: Flock · Owl, the eyes. Ember: glowing eyes at night. Its avatar and greeting glow.

tokens.name: flock-magpie
tokens.usage: Flock · Magpie, the second brain. Rose. Its avatar and memory view.

tokens.name: flock-peacock
tokens.usage: Flock · Peacock, the showcase. Orchid: the show-off. Its avatar, clips and devlog accents.

tokens.name: flock-wren-tint
tokens.usage: Flock · a 14% wash of Wren's colour: its chat bubbles, the corner wash on its cards, its tags. Never under another bird's content.

tokens.name: flock-swift-tint
tokens.usage: Flock · a 14% wash of Swift's colour: its chat bubbles, the corner wash on its cards, its tags. Never under another bird's content.

tokens.name: flock-crow-tint
tokens.usage: Flock · a 14% wash of Crow's colour: its chat bubbles, the corner wash on its cards, its tags. Never under another bird's content.

tokens.name: flock-owl-tint
tokens.usage: Flock · a 14% wash of Owl's colour: its chat bubbles, the corner wash on its cards, its tags. Never under another bird's content.

tokens.name: flock-magpie-tint
tokens.usage: Flock · a 14% wash of Magpie's colour: its chat bubbles, the corner wash on its cards, its tags. Never under another bird's content.

tokens.name: flock-peacock-tint
tokens.usage: Flock · a 14% wash of Peacock's colour: its chat bubbles, the corner wash on its cards, its tags. Never under another bird's content.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Default · fill for floating panels (menus, popovers, sheets, toasts), always with effect blur-glass behind it. Never on cards or page sections.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hero name. Once per page.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Project titles and big moments in the Nest app.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: A Go CLI that builds and deploys FTC code in one command.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: It hops to the robot's Wi-Fi, installs, and hops back.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Dates, tags and metadata, always uppercase.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Comfortable density: sections breathe (space-9), cards stay snug (space-5).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a component: tag to tag, icon to text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Small stacks: meta line to title.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gap between cards; button padding sides; stacks inside a card.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (Comfortable).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section heading to its content; space between groups in a card.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between subsections on a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side margin on desktop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between page sections (Comfortable).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top of the hero; between the biggest page moments.

radius.note: Crisp corners: precise and technical. Bird avatars and status dots are always circles (radius-full).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, status pills, small chips, chat bubble tail corner.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus items, thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, chat bubbles, popovers, media frames.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Nest app windows, sheets and large panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Circles only: bird avatars, status dots, toggles.

shadow.note: Glow depth: lifted cards with a lit top edge, warm clay glow on hover and focus, birds glow in their own colour.

tokens.name: shadow-rest
tokens.usage: Cards at rest: a thin lit top edge and a soft deep drop.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Hovered or selected cards: rises 3px and picks up a warm clay glow. Only one glowing thing at a time.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Floating panels on glass: menus, popovers, sheets, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on any control: a clay ring offset from the element, with a soft glow.

tokens.name: glow-wren
tokens.usage: Flock · Wren's avatar while it is active or speaking.

tokens.name: glow-swift
tokens.usage: Flock · Swift's avatar while it is active or speaking.

tokens.name: glow-crow
tokens.usage: Flock · Crow's avatar while it is active or speaking.

tokens.name: glow-owl
tokens.usage: Flock · Owl's avatar while it is active or speaking.

tokens.name: glow-magpie
tokens.usage: Flock · Magpie's avatar while it is active or speaking.

tokens.name: glow-peacock
tokens.usage: Flock · Peacock's avatar while it is active or speaking.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter for floating panels, over the glass fill.

tokens.name: lift-hover
tokens.usage: translateY for a card on hover, with shadow-glow.

duration.note: Motion is quick and soft. Nothing a person waits on takes longer than slow; only ambient breathing is long.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback: a button dipping under the pointer, a toggle catching.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and focus colour changes on buttons, tags, rows and links.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: A card rising into its glow, a pill changing state, a message arriving.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Panels, sheets and popovers entering; a bird action animating in. The longest anything a person waits on may take. Exits run at about 60% of this.

tokens.name: duration-breathe
tokens.usage: Ambient only: an active bird's glow slowly breathing. Never for a response to a click.

easing.note: Soft landings. Things decelerate into place; nothing starts abruptly or overshoots except Wren's hop.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: The default. Anything entering, rising or changing state: starts fast, lands softly.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things that move from one place to another on screen, and the breathing glow.

tokens.name: ease-hop
tokens.usage: A small overshoot, for Wren's menu bar hop and nothing else.
